description:
Trends charts one exercise at a time, so there is no view of whether total work is rising or falling. Add a session-volume line, plus a 4w/12w/1y/all toggle that the existing charts can share.

The fuel history endpoint already accepts a days parameter; reuse that shape rather than inventing a second one. Volume only means something for weighted sets, so sessions of reps, time or distance work need an honest representation rather than a zero.
title: Whole-workout volume trend with time ranges
